Description: Enable customers to browse, customise and place coffee orders through an intuitive self-service touch screen.
Let customers pay securely by credit card and receive a printed receipt that proves the purchase.
Allow the cafe manager to maintain menu items and prices without developer help.
Keep the kiosk fast enough to serve peak-hour queues.
As a customer, I want to browse and select from Espresso, Americano and Latte, so that I can choose my preferred beverage.
As a customer, I want to choose Small or Large and see the price for that size, so that I pay the right amount for the portion I want.
As a customer, I want to review my coffee, size and total before paying, so that I can catch mistakes before I am charged.
As a customer, I want to cancel my order at any step before payment, so that I am never charged for an order I no longer want.
As a customer, I want to pay for my order with a credit card, so that I can complete my purchase at the kiosk.
As a customer, I want to be told when my card is declined and try another card once, so that I can still get my coffee.
As a customer, I want to receive a printed receipt with my order number, so that I can collect my drink and keep proof of purchase.
As a cafe owner, I want card numbers and CVVs never to be stored on the kiosk, so that customers can trust the kiosk and we stay PCI-DSS compliant.
As a cafe manager, I want to log in to an admin screen with a PIN, so that only staff can change the menu.
As a cafe manager, I want to edit the price of any menu item, so that the kiosk always shows current prices.
As a cafe manager, I want to disable an item when it is out of stock, so that customers cannot order drinks we cannot make.
As a customer in a peak-hour queue, I want to finish my order in under 60 seconds, so that I do not hold up the people behind me.
